name: @shortcutkit/dom
description: Browser keyboard and mouse input, a shortcut recorder, text-input and IME gating, keyboard layout and localStorage persistence for @shortcutkit/core.

scripts.check-package: pnpm run build && mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && pnpm pack --out node_modules/.cache/package.tgz && publint --strict node_modules/.cache/package.tgz && attw --profile esm-only node_modules/.cache/package.tgz && node scripts/check-example.mjs node_modules/.cache/package.tgz
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run test && pnpm run check-package
